Independently solve each binary question. Check whether exactly one option is supported by the stated assumptions. Set unique=false and explain blockers for ambiguity or an invalid key. Use an empty blockers string if none. Give a brief mathematical reason for every answer. Do not use external tools.
[{"item_id": "T001", "family": "integer_bin_packing", "stem": "Ten indivisible objects have weights 8, 8, 6, 6, 4, 4, 3, 3, 3, 3. Each bin can hold total weight at most 10. Objects cannot be split. What is the minimum number of bins?", "options": {"A": "5", "B": "6"}}, {"item_id": "T002", "family": "optimal_binary_prefix_code", "stem": "Seven symbols occur 3, 5, 8, 12, 17, 24, and 31 times. Assign each symbol a distinct binary codeword so that no codeword is a prefix of another. There is no alphabetical-order constraint. What is the minimum total number of bits for encoding all 100 symbol occurrences?", "options": {"A": "252", "B": "254"}}, {"item_id": "T003", "family": "rank_one_determinant", "stem": "What is the determinant of the 4 by 4 matrix with rows (3, -1, 2, -2), (1, 2, 2, -2), (1, -1, 7, -2), and (1, -1, 2, 5)?", "options": {"A": "210", "B": "269"}}, {"item_id": "T004", "family": "bipartite_matching_deficiency", "stem": "Eight workers A through H can each perform at most one task, and each task can be assigned to at most one worker. Eligible task sets are A:{1,2}, B:{2,3}, C:{1,3}, D:{1,2,3}, E:{4,5}, F:{5,6}, G:{6,7,8}, H:{4,7,8}. Assigning every worker is optional. What is the maximum number of tasks that can be assigned?", "options": {"A": "7", "B": "8"}}, {"item_id": "T005", "family": "overlapping_pattern_waiting_time", "stem": "A fair coin is flipped independently until the consecutive four-flip pattern HHTH first appears. Counting all flips from the start, including the final four, what is the expected number of flips? Overlapping candidate occurrences are allowed.", "options": {"A": "16", "B": "18"}}, {"item_id": "T006", "family": "weighted_interval_scheduling", "stem": "A single machine can run any subset of these jobs. Each tuple is (start time, end time, profit): [(0, 3, 12), (1, 2, 5), (2, 5, 15), (3, 4, 6), (4, 7, 18), (5, 6, 7), (6, 9, 21), (7, 8, 8), (8, 11, 24), (9, 10, 9), (10, 13, 27), (11, 12, 10)]. A job occupies the half-open interval [start,end); jobs ending exactly when another begins are compatible. No job may be split, shifted or repeated. What is the largest achievable total profit?", "options": {"A": "84", "B": "78"}}]
